people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live. The princes of the congregation swore to them.
translations.bsb: And Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.
translations.kjv: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware
translations.asv: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
